description:
List the Agent Toolbox: agentic build tools (Cline, Aider, OpenHands, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Devin, Jules, Kiro, Amp, Warp, n8n, Browser Use and more) by category.

Use when: the user wants options for an agent of a given kind (CLI, IDE, autonomous SWE, browser, workflow) or only open-source ones. For harness features (MCP, subagents, sandboxing) use list_harnesses.

Behavior: Read-only. Per tool: what it is, best use, open-source licence (checked on GitHub) and official pricing with source and date.

Example: {"category":"CLI agent","open_source":true}
name: list_agent_tools
title: List agentic coding tools
